result.note: Mostly an unadopted lobbying push, so one question tests durable facts about Aadhaar and UIDAI's role.

questions.prompt: In March 2026, it was reported that the Indian government was asking smartphone makers to pre-install the Aadhaar app on new phones. Consider the following statements:
items: Aadhaar is a 12-digit identity number linked to an individual's fingerprints and iris scans.
The updated Aadhaar app released in January 2026 lets users manage family profiles and secure their biometric data against unauthorised use.
The push to preload the Aadhaar app on smartphones came from the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the request came from the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), which wants wider reach without an App Store download. Industry body MAIT is pushing back, citing higher production costs and the need for India-specific assembly lines.
questions.source: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) wants the Aadhaar app preloaded into smartphones to enhance reach and skip the App Store download.
